description.value: A Subway franchise located on Terminal Avenue North in Nanaimo, offering sandwiches, wraps, salads, and breakfast items. As an independently owned and operated location, it serves both dine-in and takeout customers with fresh-made-to-order options. Touring cyclists passing through Nanaimo will find it a convenient stop for a customizable meal with vegetable-heavy options.

address.value: 1150 Terminal Avenue North, Unit 4, Nanaimo, BC V9S 5L6
